item.tib: che mchog dran pa yang gsang drag po'i rgyud dbang drag drag sgrub lcags sdig nag po
item.coloph: bdag 'dra o rgyan sangs rgyas gling pas rab brtan lcags phag lo'i zla tshes shar phyogs gnas chen ri'i byang phyogs ge ta brag ces nyi ma rang shar gnas kyi g.yon phyogs/ mkha' 'gro seng gdong phug nas rigs mthun mkha' 'gro'i grogs dang bcas te/ zab mo khrom gter du bgyis pa lags shing / slar zla tshes (la) bstan 'dzin sa bdag rgyal po'i pho brang drug zur rnam rgyal rdzong gi dbus rtse nas/ shog ser bod yig tu bsgyur ba bgyis so//
